issue_request: FHIR-51930 is an Applied/Persuasive R6 BR&R change request to remove/delete SubstanceNucleicAcid, SubstancePolymer, SubstanceProtein, SubstanceReferenceInformation, and SubstanceSourceMaterial from the FHIR specification after a 9-0-0 BR&R vote.
initial_application: The request was applied before this reconciliation. Commit cdb8db05ba4a2776fb5089266c765ed711d9fd93 removed SubstanceDefinition references for the unwanted content, and commit b595760a8a140b57e6e0733823bdeab5dc8e7863 removed active fhir.ini entries, resource folders, compartments/hierarchy entries, and current resourcelist/module references for the five resources.
additional_context: The cited BR&R 2025-06-10 minutes record the motion and vote, the FMG Zulip thread records Rik Smithies saying the MedicationDefinition FMM 0 resources were to be removed totally with relevant content moved elsewhere, and September 2025 BR&R WGM minutes list the five resources as previously decided to be removed/retired. Remaining exact-name matches are historical/package-history data, OID assignments, the R2/R3/R4 resource-name tracker, legacy publish category entries, or SubstanceDefinition source-material terminology, not active current resource definitions.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source/fhir.ini [resources] list has SubstanceDefinition but none of the five removed resources; the five resource source directories are absent; and current resource-list/module pages do not link to them.
